label: nyiso 2 chp covered
definition: REJECTED (negligible) P12 probe. Hypothesis: the CHP under-dispatch (CC_CHP -14.6%, CT_CHP -44%, ST_CHP -18% vs EIA-923) is a startup-amortization artifact, so --chp-startup-covered (steam-host cogen pays no energy-market cold start) lets CHP run toward its must-run reality. Result: CHP moved only +0.1 TWh total (CC_CHP +0.03, ST_CHP +0.05, CT_CHP +0.02; CC_REGULAR -0.03, ST_GAS -0.05; gas total 57.53->57.54; avg $42.72->$43.02). The CHP/peaker deficit is STRUCTURAL (model dispatches CHP economically, no hard steam-host must-run floor), not a startup-cost artifact, and the basis-capped total leaves no room. Keeper unchanged.
